# Observability for Agents {#sec-observability}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- instrument an agent with OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions;
- navigate a trace hierarchy from session down to a single tool call;
- attribute token cost to a user, a team, and a feature;
- debug a real failure from its trace instead of from a log grep.

## Exercises

1. Instrument an agent and produce a cost-per-session breakdown by feature. Which feature is most expensive per resolved task?
2. Take a failing session and write the root-cause analysis using only the trace. Note what you wished you had instrumented.
